(2) **Does the top-right area show a bell/notifications icon?**
**Yes.** There is a bell icon located in the top-right toolbar.

(3) **Does the bell show any unread-count badge?**
**No.** The bell icon does not display any numerical badge or red dot indicating unread notifications.

(4) **Is there an avatar/account button at the top right?**
**Yes.** To the right of the bell icon, there is a circular pink button containing the letter "D", which serves as the account/avatar button for the signed-in user.

(5) **How many rail entries read 'History'?**
**One.** The label "History" appears exactly once in the navigation rail (under the "You" sub-header).
